description: Depression and anxiety on treatment (id and every label deliberately neutral: nothing it shows or sends names the condition). Only patients on an active antidepressant, anxiolytic or hypnotic (ATC N06A, N05B, N05C) are in it: an F32/F33/F41 diagnosis alone does not enroll (psychotherapy is followed by the doctor's plan and the visit cadence), and an antidepressant without a coded diagnosis enrolls as F32. A discharge ends it. A control with the prescriber (psychiatry or primary care: a psychotherapy session is not it) 2 to 4 weeks after an antidepressant is started or its dose changes, then monthly until 3 consecutive controls without a change, then every 3 months. Fills only what the doctor's plan did not cover.
